en.title: Checksum over All Ordered Packet Pairs
en.description:
Packets are numbered 1..n, and C(i,j)=i mod j+j mod i. Find the sum of C over all ordered pairs modulo 1000000007. The diagonal terms are 0, so it makes no difference whether the pairs must consist of distinct packets.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site; missing numeric bounds and recoveries of source typos are all stated explicitly.
en.input: One line containing n; complete OCR bound 1≤n≤1000000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2; 10; 24. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: By symmetry, compute 2 times Σ(i mod j). Fix j; when n=qj+r, the complete remainder cycles contribute q·j(j−1)/2, and the remainder contributes r(r+1)/2.
